supersession_reason: The v2 source-domain matrix was an implementation-level allocation introduced before the first eligibility audit. The audit, still with Candidate-v13 unexecuted, proved PerLTQA non-profile source integrity inadequate and proved the original generic domain classifier semantically overbroad. v3 preserves every preregistered formal invariant—exact stage sizes, 8 equal domains, 12 equal structural families, answerable/no-evidence totals, at least three source families, <=45% per source, fixed seeds, thresholds and one-shot rules—while replacing the invalid source and removing an unnecessary fixed source-by-domain cross-table. Exact source marginals and exact domain marginals are now both enforced by deterministic capacity flow over source-native domain labels.

source_domain_flow.rule: For each stage, compute source×domain available unique-base capacities after earlier-stage exclusion. Solve a deterministic max-flow from source nodes with exact stage_source_targets to domain nodes with exact domain_targets through source-domain capacity edges. Edge insertion order is lexical source/domain order; max-flow implementation and resulting matrix are hashed. If full stage flow is impossible, stop before Candidate-v13 execution; do not change source/domain totals.
source_domain_flow.persist_before_formal_freeze: Only aggregate source-domain flow matrix and hashes may be persisted during eligibility. Individual EV-B/EV-C base item IDs are not persisted before freeze.

family_feasibility.rule: After a feasible source-domain flow matrix is known, eligibility audit may perform an ephemeral deterministic b-matching using unique base cases as unit-capacity nodes between source-domain cells and eligible N1-N12 family nodes. It may persist only feasibility status, aggregate cell/family counts, and a SHA256 digest of the ephemeral selected base IDs; it must not persist the selected EV-B/EV-C IDs or natural-language payload before freeze.
family_feasibility.failure: Any family infeasibility blocks Candidate-v13 execution until a source-only/evaluator-integrity defect is resolved within preregistration. After first Candidate-v13 external output, no family/source rule changes are permitted.

no_evidence_assignment.N10: Every case assigned primary family N10 is no-evidence by withholding all gold IDs.
no_evidence_assignment.remaining_quota: Additional no-evidence cases are chosen from already selected non-N10 base cases by deterministic SHA256(stage seed, base_item_id) order and receive the same gold-withholding transform. Query text is unchanged.
no_evidence_assignment.gold_metadata: Evaluator retains original source-native gold IDs privately to score false retrieval; Candidate-v13 never sees them.

dimensions.implicit_relation: SGD carry-over case where carried slot is absent from current frame.slots
dimensions.no_evidence_ambiguity: no-evidence transformed case that is also N3-, N9-, or N11-eligible
dimensions.multi_clause: natural query has >=2 comma/semicolon/parenthetical boundaries or >=2 source turns are concatenated as source-native context

ev_c_stress_requirement.rule: For every dimension with at least 100 eligible EV-C-reserve base cases after EV-A/EV-B exclusion, EV-C selected proportion must exceed EV-B by at least 0.01. Failure to satisfy this before formal freeze is an infrastructure/evaluation-design blocker, not a threshold relaxation opportunity.
